capabilities: Imports highlights and notes from My Clippings.txt over USB
Creates one note per book in Kindle Highlights format
Merges new highlights incrementally without deleting existing content
Deduplicates revised highlights, keeping the longest and most recent
Appends missing highlights to existing Kindle Highlights notes
disambiguation: Not a cloud sync or Kindle manager; it only imports My Clippings.txt from a USB-connected Kindle into vault notes.
extras: Desktop-only (isDesktopOnly); no network requests; no runtime dependencies; CI fails on any SAST/SCA finding; MIT license; README written in Portuguese.
intentEvidence: no mesmo formato das notas do plugin Kindle Highlights
problem: Highlights from Kindle books that did not come from Amazon (sent by USB or Calibre) never sync to the cloud and exist only in My Clippings.txt, so they cannot reach Obsidian.

relations.evidence: no mesmo formato das notas do plugin Kindle Highlights

summary: Plugin that imports highlights and notes from a USB Kindle's My Clippings.txt into one note per book, in Kindle Highlights format.
